rows.custody: No custody state or wallet custody claim proven by this landing/rates audit.
rows.kyc: Landing advertises no KYC; this does not establish provider-specific behavior or verified-lane readiness.
rows.fees: Public quote widget is information; final transaction fees must be established downstream.

rows.accidentalTap: CTA navigates; it is not a transfer or order POST.

rows.entry: One explicit Create order form submission validates session, CSRF, amount, offered direction and destination, then creates order and payment session.
rows.executor: Page is within ObsidianExchange; no complete transaction-specific executor review block found in the scoped form.
rows.custody: Recipient wallet field and personal-wallet/no-tag choice are present; full before/during/after custody explanation not established.
rows.kyc: No transaction-specific KYC row in the scoped form.
rows.fees: Dynamic fee/receive display and server-derived commission tiers exist. Bank-fee wording was observed, not independently verified.
rows.irreversibility: Network/tag mismatch warnings are present; no comprehensive irreversible-action acknowledgement in the scoped form.
rows.accidentalTap: Explicit submit plus CSRF and server destination checks; no additional confirmation dialog. An order/payment intent is not itself a transfer.
rows.evidence: New exact handler probes prove unauthenticated, CSRF and invalid-address branches reach no inert effect boundary; valid form reaches order creation before session creation.

rows.entry: Amount/captcha/destination flow; valid typed or saved destination leads to pending order and payment-method choice.
rows.executor: Bot branding plus later payment partner selection; no unified executor review in the inspected creation message.
rows.custody: Prompt asks where coins should be sent after payment; address/tag warnings distinguish personal wallet and exchange. Full custody lifecycle not established.
rows.kyc: No transaction-specific KYC row in the inspected creation card.
rows.fees: Created-order card displays actual commission, RUB total and agreed crypto amount before payment method selection.
rows.irreversibility: Address-entry prompt warns wrong-network coins are lost; tag handling requires explicit answer. Created-order card omits full destination and network.
rows.accidentalTap: Saved-address callback verifies ownership, current validation and direction, then creates pending order. A saved-address tap does not transfer funds.
rows.evidence: New exact probes show foreign/stale saved addresses and invalid typed addresses do not reach creation; owned address reaches inert creation with correct user id. Card omission is directly captured, not claimed as a live incident.

rows.entry: Collect crypto amount and RUB recipient; create sell order and display destination/deposit details. Transfer occurs separately in the customer wallet.
rows.executor: Bot says send coins to us and receive RUB; final staff copy may describe payment partner. No unified customer executor proof in this scoped audit.
rows.custody: Deposit-address workflow is visible; whole custody lifecycle not established by source wording alone.
rows.kyc: No dedicated transaction-specific KYC review proved in scoped SELL views.
rows.fees: Server-derived sell fee/market/receive values are shown; exact calculation coverage belongs to existing pricing tests, not this audit.
rows.irreversibility: Network/comment requirements shown where relevant; comprehension and blockchain-wallet confirmation remain unverified.
rows.accidentalTap: Creation and wallet transfer are distinct; this read-only audit did not execute sell/store/payout routines.
rows.evidence: Source observation only for these surfaces. No fresh bot SELL/provider/payout execution or blanket gate pass is claimed.

rows.entry: Bot shows estimated receive before destination entry, then invokes provider create_swap after validated address; site form submits pair/amount/address.
rows.executor: Bot rejection for unsupported tag identifies an external service. General menu does not name the provider in its main quote.
rows.custody: Website says no participation of our addresses; this is not independent proof of provider custody or risk.
rows.kyc: Bot/site say no KYC; actual external provider policy is outside this code-only audit.
rows.fees: Approximate 1% advertised. Bot shows estimate before address. Site text claims final amount before confirmation, but scoped template has no quote output or calculation script; downstream behavior not executed.
rows.irreversibility: Tag-losing swap destinations are rejected; whole irreversible-action review not established.
rows.accidentalTap: Provider intent creation is distinct from external-wallet transfer. No provider, order or wallet calls were made.
rows.evidence: Static source scope only. Missing browser/handler coverage is a gap, not an invented production failure or instruction to widen the current patch.

User messaging must preserve an unknown outcome and avoid automatic resubmission/signing. This is the current bounded code-fix priority; site/bot coverage facts do not widen it.
